_about: Spenser's (c.1552-1599) The Faerie Queene, J. C. Smith's Oxford text (1909), two volumes on Gutenberg. PG 6930 (another FQ edition) carries the COPYRIGHTED marker and is excluded; PG 15272 is Book I only. Added from the classical reading lists (Classical Conversations, Canon Press, New Saint Andrews, Logos School/Online, Bethlehem College & Seminary, Memoria Press, CiRCE): docs/reading-lists/READING-LISTS.tsv. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 (Bloom's Western Canon): spenser-minor-poems.

spenser-faerie-queene-smith-1: Spenser's Faerie Queene, ed. J. C. Smith (1909), vol. 1: Books I-III
spenser-faerie-queene-smith-2: Spenser's Faerie Queene, ed. J. C. Smith (1909), vol. 2: Books IV-VII

spenser-minor-poems: Spenser's Minor Poems, ed. Ernest de Selincourt

_excluded.spenser-faerie-queene-book1-15272: Book I only (Wauchope school ed.); covered by the Smith text

spenser-minor-poems.year: 1910 (title page: 'Oxford at the Clarendon Press MCMX')
spenser-minor-poems.evidence: Read title page and introduction opening.
spenser-minor-poems.case: Bloom's title matches de Selincourt's Oxford volume exactly; we hold only the Faerie Queene.
spenser-minor-poems.note: PG 10602 (Child vol. 5) is apparatus only, not the minor poems.
